purpose: What Benchmark 001 composes and which gates it must pass. Configuration for scripts/run-benchmark-001.mjs: the harness is generic, this file is the benchmark's composition. Nothing here is a creative outcome; the outcome comes from the run.

background.note: a fixture choice; cream stays an allowed token and is not a required background

product.note: the whole real photograph as a rectangular photo (decision://habb/benchmark-001/pixel-preserve-whole-photo): no crop, no relight, no rotation, no shadow, no segmentation

headline.content_basis: an authorised HABB copy variant for Benchmark 001 (a new governed decision); non-claim creative text, no number, no fact

speed_claim.note: the visible text is the qualified display claim "Coque personnalisée en 5 minutes" (decision://habb/benchmark-001/qualified-speed-display)

not_composed: No logo (no approved logo asset ref exists), no CTA and no decoration: nothing is invented to fill a slot.

all_of: readiness is RUNNABLE with the verified private payload
the document is built from the bound product, the real asset and the approved claims only
Creative Fidelity PASS: all five required checks (PRODUCT_IDENTITY, PRODUCT_GEOMETRY, PIECE_COUNT, PRODUCT_COLOR, TEXT) measured on the delivered PNG and PASS
Brand Guardian PASS: hard rules R1 palette, R2 typography families, R3 product_fidelity gate, all applicable and PASS
a real PNG is produced from a RESOLVED render with real typography

verdicts.PASS: every gate PASS and the PNG exists
verdicts.FAIL: a gate is evaluated and fails
verdicts.BLOCKED: a required gate cannot be measured (NOT_MEASURABLE) or a required condition is missing: no PASS is inferred
